seed.confirm:
Seed demo data?

This DELETES every classroom and pupil in this school and replaces them with a demo set. This cannot be undone.

Only do this on a demo/test school.
seed.title: Set up a demo school
seed.body: Fills this school with a realistic two-form-entry set — 6 classes, ~160 pupils grouped by level across year groups. Replaces any existing classrooms.

windowsPage.title: Assessment Windows
windowsPage.intro: Schools assess at entry and in half-termly windows. Between windows, teachers move children through the pathway using professional judgement — children are not formally tested after every book.

libraryPreview.title: Library — 33 books
libraryPreview.intro: Same shipped books and PDFs as production, regrouped under the 8-level structure. The pill on each card shows the original (parent-6) sub-level for cross-reference.

library.title: Library
library.intro: {{count}}+ linked resources across 8 levels — every Sound Book, Blending Book, Storybook, interactive version, worksheet, sound mat and tricky word set, organised by type.
library.soundWorksheetDesc: Sound formation, word building and sound sorting. Companion to the <book>{{title}}</book>.
library.blendingDesc: A6 word-reveal booklet. No separate worksheet — the blending practice is the resource.
library.interactiveDesc: Tappable words, phoneme pop-ups, audio, spelling, story ordering, comprehension and writing practice.
library.interactiveDescGrammar: Tappable words, phoneme pop-ups, audio, spelling, story ordering, comprehension, grammar word-order and writing practice.
library.packDesc: 5-page A4 pack: sound hunt, trace and write, read and do, alien words, story-and-draw.
library.soundMatDesc: Cumulative GPC chart showing the sounds taught at this level and earlier levels.
library.trickyCardsDesc: Tricky word cards for the words introduced at this level.
